We engaged this agency for growth marketing but were disappointed with the experience. Communication was often inconsistent, responses delayed, and the strategies felt outdated, leading to only limited improvement despite a substantial investment. It appears the agency may be taking on projects outside their expertise, which affected the quality of work delivered.

Instead of asking for a refund, we reviewed their online presence and noticed some discrepancies. Their high LinkedIn follower count and five-star reviews didn’t match with our experience. We also observed that some team members, and ex members left ratings themselves, raising doubts about the credibility of these reviews. Additionally, they may be posting job listings on LinkedIn to increase their follower base, a common practice for every marketing agency to create a good impression.

While we generally avoid leaving negative feedback, we hope sharing our honest experience will help others make informed decisions regarding this agency’s services.
